title: tradeskillframe
summary: Program.Professions.cs is MSUI's TradeSkillFrame: opens client-side off the effect-47 opener spell (TryOpenProfession), ClassTrainer/TradeSkill shell art, skill line title + rank value, scrolled recipe list with vanilla difficulty colors (orange/yellow/green/grey from trivial thresholds), detail pane with product icon, reagents with have/need counts red-tinted when short, tools and spell-focus requirement lines with red unmet tint, Create / Create All (batched recasts) / Cancel / Exit, craft-cast confirmation observation. Structural list features of the ref/Benilla are absent.

openItems.text: Flat recipe list: no collapsible subclass group headers (+/- fold rows), no Collapse All button
No filter dropdowns (subclass filter, inventory-slot filter)
Skill rank shows as text 'value / max' with no status-bar fill (ref TradeSkillRankFrame is a StatusBar)
List scrolls by mouse wheel only - no scrollbar widget on the recipe list (the trainer window has one; this one does not)
No item tooltips on the product icon or reagent rows
No creation-count spinner (ref's number input with +/- and the typed count next to Create)
